Right on cue! Look who is coming down the stairs carrying a green book!

lines.trans: I only pressed the bell once upstairs, Chen, and your friendly wire rang twice like usual.

words.gloss: measure word for pipes, wires, sticks

lines.trans: If Room Four ever rang only once, Teacher Song, I would think it was broken.
Here is that green cloth-covered garden herb book from the old bookshop shelf on Wutong Lane!

lines.trans: Look at the gold lettering stamped on the faded green cover: Courtyard Herbs and Blossoms!
Open the inside front cover first and look—old neighbours always loved writing their street number there.
Sharp eyes, Chen! Pencilled in the corner is our exact street number from thirty years ago!
So this book actually belonged to Manager Zhou and his aunt before it reached the bookshop shelf!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yī. Changes tone to yí before 4th tone (一个 yí gè) and yì before 1st/2nd/3rd tones (一杯 yì bēi).

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yí yàng. Pairs with 跟/和 in 跟…一样 ('the same as…').

examples.text: 等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！
examples.trans: Wait—it is dark blue, the same as yours!

examples.text: 哎呀！我跑得太急，包装看着都一样！
examples.trans: Oh no! I was running in such a rush that the wrappers all looked alike!

meanings.note: Pinyin: qī. Cardinal number 7; combines with 月 for July and 点 for seven o'clock.

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

examples.text: 七点半有八位饿肚子的客人下楼啊！
examples.trans: At seven thirty, eight hungry guests are coming downstairs!

meanings.note: Pinyin: sān shí. Cardinal number thirty ('three tens'); pairs directly with measure words like 三十年 ('thirty years').

examples.text: 这棵老树在院子里长了三十年。
examples.trans: This old tree has grown in the courtyard for thirty years.

examples.text: 从客栈走到地铁站只要三十分钟。
examples.trans: Walking from the inn to the metro station takes only thirty minutes.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng. Used both as a directional verb/complement ('up, onto') and location word ('on top of').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià. Used for downward motion ('go down'), location ('under'), or 'next' (下周).

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liǎng. Used instead of 二 when counting things with a measure word (两个, 两把, 两间).

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǔ. Cardinal number 9.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

examples.text: 九分钟！牛奶、鸡蛋和苹果都买来了！
examples.trans: Nine minutes! The milk, eggs, and apples are all here!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shū. Measure word (量词): 本 (běn), e.g. 一本书 ('a book').

examples.text: 书桌上放着两本安静的旧书。
examples.trans: Two old books sit on the desk.

examples.text: 她喜欢坐在院子里看书。
examples.trans: She likes sitting in the courtyard reading a book.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shū diàn. Combines 书 ('book') + 店 ('shop'); measure word: 家 (jiā).

examples.text: 原来只是隔壁书店的老板顺路帮我们送信。
examples.trans: It turned out to be only the bookshop owner next door dropping off our mail.

examples.text: 梧桐巷转角那家老书店每天下午都飘着茶香。
examples.trans: The old bookshop on the corner of Wutong Lane smells of tea every afternoon.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shū jià. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个书架 ('a bookcase').

examples.text: 看这个箭头——指着走廊里的书架！
examples.trans: Look at this arrow—it points at the bookcase in the hallway!

examples.text: 那个大书架靠着那面墙，已经二十年了！
examples.trans: That big bookcase has stood against that wall for twenty years!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shū zhuō. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张书桌 ('a desk').

examples.text: 有，结实的木床、干净书桌，风景全院最好。
examples.trans: Yes, a solid wooden bed, a clean desk, and the best view in the courtyard.

examples.text: 挂在书桌右边吧，那里光线好。
examples.trans: Hang it to the right of the desk, where the light is good.

meanings.note: Pinyin: le. After a verb, marks completion; at the end of a sentence, signals a change of situation.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tā. Third-person singular masculine pronoun; pronounced identically to 她 and 它.

examples.text: 他没要回那个装木头小火车的箱子吗？
examples.trans: Did he not ask back for that case with the wooden train?

examples.text: 他留了纸条，请我们保管到星期五。
examples.trans: He left a note asking us to keep it until Friday.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǐ wéi. Signals a belief that turned out not to be true ('I thought…, but actually…').

examples.text: 成都旅游指南？等等——你们以为我是酒店评审员？
examples.trans: The Chengdu Travel Guide? Wait—did you think I am a hotel inspector?

examples.text: 我以为卖房子时早就丢了！为什么一直替我留着？
examples.trans: I thought it was lost long ago when we sold the house! Why keep it for me?

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǐ qián. Measure word (量词): 段, e.g. 以前的日子 ('days in the past').

examples.text: 说实话，我比以前灰色办公室喜欢这儿多了。
examples.trans: Honestly, I like this place far better than my old grey office.

examples.text: 哦？您家里人以前住在这附近吗？
examples.trans: Oh? Did your family live near here once?

related.gloss: days in the past (measure word 段)

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàng. Introduces a likeness or example ('look like, be like').

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 他长得真像他哥哥。
examples.trans: He really looks like his older brother.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiān. Placed before the verb to sequence actions: 先…再… ('first…, then…').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiě. Used for writing characters, notes, letters, or reviews.

examples.text: 到星期五？没写名字，也没签名！
examples.trans: Until Friday? No name written, and no signature either!

examples.text: 只剩三十五分钟了！他肯定会写一星差评！
examples.trans: Only thirty-five minutes left! He will surely write a one-star bad review!

meanings.note: Pinyin: bié. Most commonly means 'do not' in polite commands (别担心 'don't worry'); as a verb, 'pin/clip on'.

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

examples.text: 您先坐下，别着急，我们马上看行李牌。
examples.trans: Please sit down first and do not worry; we will check the luggage tag right away.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dào. Works as main verb ('arrive') or result complement ('succeed in reaching/perceiving', 找到, 听到).

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qián. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个前面 ('a front side').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

meanings.note: Printing cards, posters, or documents.

examples.text: 行政部刚帮新入职的同事印好了名片。
examples.trans: Administration just printed business cards for the new hires.

examples.text: 宣传册上的节目播出时间千万别印错了。
examples.trans: Make sure the broadcast time on the brochure is not misprinted.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuán lái. Marks an 'aha!' discovery ('so it was X all along!').

examples.text: 原来星期五的神秘客人一直睡在我阁楼屋顶下面。
examples.trans: So our mystery Friday caller was sleeping under my attic roof all along.

examples.text: 原来留着爷爷旧物的神秘人一直是你，志豪。
examples.trans: So the mystery person holding Grandfather's keepsake was you all along, Zhihao.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qù. Movement away from the speaker, as main verb (去车站) or directional complement (上去).

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ. Read zhǐ as the adverb 'only' before verbs, and zhī as a measure word for cups, boxes, and small animals.

examples.text: 而且他今晚八点到这里——只剩四十分钟了！
examples.trans: And he arrives here at eight o'clock this evening—in forty minutes!

examples.text: 只剩三十五分钟了！他肯定会写一星差评！
examples.trans: Only thirty-five minutes left! He will surely write a one-star bad review!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hào. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个号码 ('a number').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hào mǎ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个号码 ('a number').

examples.text: 上面有名字或者电话号码吗？
examples.trans: Is there a name or a phone number on it?

examples.text: 可惜没有电话号码，只有两个字母和老街名字。
examples.trans: Unfortunately there is no phone number, only two letters and an old street name.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ya. Gentle exclamation of surprise or realization.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 呀，这就是星期一火车上那只双胞胎箱子吗？
examples.trans: Oh, is this that twin suitcase from Monday's train?

meanings.note: Pinyin: ne. After a noun, asks 'what about X?' (你呢？); at the end of a statement, highlights an ongoing situation.

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hū xī. Pairs with 深 in 深呼吸 ('take a deep breath').

examples.text: 深呼吸，周经理。还没人写任何东西呢。
examples.trans: Take a deep breath, Manager Zhou. Nobody has written anything yet.

examples.text: 雨后院子里的空气呼吸起来特别舒服。
examples.trans: After the rain, the courtyard air feels wonderful to breathe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé. Joins nouns or pronouns ('A and B'), NEVER two whole clauses; also means 'with' (和你一样).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎng. Used for bells, phones, pipes, or alarms ringing or clanking.

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǎ. Combines with a measure word to ask 'which?' (哪个 'which one?', 哪间 'which room?').

examples.text: 等一下，小晴……你拿了哪一包黄油？
examples.trans: Wait a second, Qing... which packet of butter did you grab?

examples.text: 对！左边有两条小路——我走哪一条？
examples.trans: Yes! There are two small lanes on the left—which one do I take?

meanings.note: Pinyin: la. Colloquial fusion of 了 + 啊 adding cheerful energy at the end of a sentence.

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 你们守着，我出门啦！
examples.trans: Hold the fort—I am heading out the door!

meanings.note: Pinyin: sì. Cardinal number 4.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huí tóu. Appears in the friendly farewell 回头见！ ('See you soon!').

examples.text: 我先去送热茶，我们回头聊！
examples.trans: Let me deliver this hot tea first—we will talk soon!

examples.text: 今天辛苦了，回头见！
examples.trans: Great work today—see you soon!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. As main verb/preposition, gives location (在院子里); before another verb, marks ongoing action ('be doing').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dì bǎn. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块地板 ('a floorboard').

examples.text: 晚上好。不好意思，把干净地板弄湿了。
examples.trans: Good evening. Sorry for getting your clean floor wet.

examples.text: 快去跟他聊聊，小晴，不然木地板都要踩破了！
examples.trans: Go talk to him quickly, Qing, or he will wear right through the wooden floorboards!

meanings.note: Pinyin: huài. Describes a broken pipe, lock, or appliance (坏了 'broke down').

examples.text: 送牛奶的车在城外坏了。你们看冰箱！
examples.trans: The milk delivery van broke down outside town. Look at the fridge!

examples.text: 坏消息。老热水器上的铜压力阀门裂了。
examples.trans: Bad news. The brass pressure valve on the old water heater cracked.

meanings.en: sound; voice; measure word for sounds
meanings.note: Pinyin: shēng. Counts cries, knocks, or chimes (一声 'one sound').

examples.text: 来不及了！他说了声谢谢就挂断了！
examples.trans: Too late! He said thank you and hung up!

examples.text: 非常安静！不过刚才你听到奇怪的金属敲击声了吗？
examples.trans: Very quiet! Though did you hear a strange metallic knocking sound just now?

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià tiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个夏天 ('a summer').

examples.text: 房东律师寄来的？奇怪——我们房租一直交到明年夏天了。
examples.trans: Sent by the landlord's lawyer? Strange—our rent is paid right through next summer.

examples.text: 夏天坐在大树底下乘凉最舒服。
examples.trans: Sitting in the shade beneath the big tree in summer is bliss.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà shēng. Combines 大 ('big/loud') + 声 ('voice/sound'); modifies verbs of speaking or reading directly (大声念 'read aloud').

examples.text: 小晴，把木牌上的字大声念给我听听吧。
examples.trans: Qing, read the words on the wooden sign aloud for me to hear.

examples.text: 周经理在院子里大声宣布九号房咖啡角正式通过了审核。
examples.trans: In the courtyard, Manager Zhou announced aloud that the Room Nine café corner had officially passed the review.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà jiā. Warm collective pronoun including everyone in the group.

examples.text: 大家早上好！欢迎你，小晴。都准备好了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning, everyone! Welcome, Qing. Is everything ready?

examples.text: 有进步！今天小院迎接兄弟重逢——大家保持安静端庄！
examples.trans: Progress! Today our courtyard hosts a brotherly reunion—quiet dignity from everyone!

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一整天 ('a whole day').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第二天上班，干得不错，新手。
examples.trans: For day two on the job, nicely done, rookie.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gū gu. Specifically father's sister (second syllable neutral tone); distinct from 阿姨 / 姨妈 (mother's sister).

examples.text: 周经理的姑姑以前也住在这座老院子里。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou's paternal aunt used to live in this old courtyard too.

examples.text: 我姑姑年轻的时候最喜欢弹钢琴。
examples.trans: When my aunt was young, she loved playing the piano most of all.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zì. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个字 ('a written character').

examples.text: 真好奇！那张行李牌上的字看着很眼熟。
examples.trans: How curious! The handwriting on that tag looked very familiar.

examples.text: 先别对外面透露一个字！让两兄弟先过完这个星期五下午！
examples.trans: Not a single word to anyone outside yet! Let the two brothers have their Friday afternoon first!

meanings.note: Pinyin: tā. Third-person singular pronoun for objects, animals, and places.

examples.text: 是啊，宋老师，还在等它的主人呢。
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, still waiting for its owner.

examples.text: 别念叨它，宋老师！我现在差不多喜欢上那两声响了。
examples.trans: Don't tempt it, Teacher Song! I have almost grown fond of those two rings now.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ān jìng. Core A1 adjective for quiet courtyards and rooms.

examples.text: 很安静，谢谢，不过这个行李箱今天特别重。
examples.trans: Very quiet, thank you, though this suitcase feels especially heavy today.

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Noun fēngmiàn ('album/magazine cover').

examples.text: 这次的封面不好看。
examples.trans: This cover does not look good.

examples.text: 谁选的封面？
examples.trans: Who picked the cover?

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo yuàn. Measure word (量词): 座 (zuò), e.g. 一座小院 ('a small courtyard').

examples.text: 有进步！今天小院迎接兄弟重逢——大家保持安静端庄！
examples.trans: Progress! Today our courtyard hosts a brotherly reunion—quiet dignity from everyone!

examples.text: 产权转让通知：八号小院整栋建筑将作为商业办公楼出售。
examples.trans: Property Transfer Notice: Courtyard Building Eight offered for sale as commercial offices.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a adj used in conversational Mandarin.

examples.text: 我有一个尖。
examples.trans: I have a 尖.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的尖。
examples.trans: This is a very good 尖.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù. Highlights immediacy, exact location (就在这里), or smooth consequence ('then').

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bù. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块布 ('a piece of cloth').

examples.text: 周经理，给您干净布和冷水。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou, here is a clean cloth and cold water for you.

examples.text: 请拿一块干净的布擦桌子。
examples.trans: Please take a clean cloth to wipe the table.

related.gloss: a piece of cloth (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: gàn. Read gàn when meaning 'do work / get a job done' (干得不错 'nicely done!').

examples.text: 第二天上班，干得不错，新手。
examples.trans: For day two on the job, nicely done, rookie.

examples.text: 不许盯着客人看。把箱子交还，干自己的活。
examples.trans: No staring at guests. Hand back the bag and do our own work.

meanings.note: Pinyin: píng shí. Measure word (量词): 段, e.g. 平时日子 ('ordinary days').

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

examples.text: 那我们平时为什么不租给客人呢？
examples.trans: Then why do we never rent it out to guests?

meanings.note: Pinyin: nián. Time classifier taking no 个 directly after numbers (六年 'six years', 今年 'this year').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 老橡木，八十年了，一滴水都不漏。
examples.trans: Old oak, eighty years old—not a single drop leaks.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kāi. Versatile verb for opening doors, starting business, turning on taps/lights, or water boiling.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 当然不能偷看……咦，自己翻开在中间那页了！
examples.trans: Of course we must not peek... oh, it fell open to the middle page by itself!

meanings.note: Pinyin: kuài. As an adjective/adverb, 'fast/quickly'; in 快…了, 'about to'.

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 小晴，快看里面！这不是我的箱子！
examples.trans: Qing, look inside quickly! This is not my case!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǒng. Indicates what consistently happens or must happen (总得有人 'somebody has to').

examples.text: 总得有人照顾院子里的花草嘛。
examples.trans: Somebody has to look after the courtyard plants, after all.

examples.text: 拿稳了！你已经关掉总水阀了吗？
examples.trans: Steady! Did you turn off the main water valve already?

meanings.note: Pinyin: nín. Respectful singular 'you' used with elders, teachers, and guests (您好！).

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ. First-person singular pronoun; add 的 for 'my' (我的) and 们 for 'we/us' (我们).

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ men. First-person plural pronoun; add 的 for 'our' (我们的).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间房 ('a room').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǎo. Focuses on searching; add 到 (找到) for actually finding.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 我正在打……您好，请问有人找蓝色行李箱吗？
examples.trans: I am calling now... Hello, excuse me, is anyone looking for a blue suitcase?

meanings.en: measure word for handled objects; disposal marker
meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎ. Counts items with handles or backs (一把钥匙, 一把椅子); as a preposition, fronts a definite object before an action verb.

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bào. Used for carrying a box, cushion, or child in both arms.

examples.text: 老陈，抱起那些纸箱，我们下楼吧！
examples.trans: Chen, pick up those cardboard boxes—down the stairs we go!

examples.text: 那抱着木头小火车的弟弟呢？
examples.trans: And what about the younger brother holding the wooden train?

meanings.note: Pinyin: àn. Used for pressing a doorbell, elevator button, or key (按门铃).

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 宋老师，怎么了？您按了门铃！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, what happened? You rang the bell!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù. Describes old houses, pipes, or letters—never a person's age (use 老 for people).

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 不在，只有我的笔和三张旧收据！
examples.trans: Not there—only my pen and three old receipts!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng qī tiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个星期天 ('a Sunday').

examples.text: 从那天起我们就再没说过话。上周我给他寄了一张明信片。
examples.trans: Since that day we have not spoken again. Last week I mailed him a postcard.

examples.text: 星期天早上大家都不急着赶车，慢慢喝早茶。
examples.trans: On Sunday mornings nobody rushes for trains, lingering over tea instead.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì. Links two nouns (我是小晴); do NOT use simple 是 before plain adjectives like 好 or 忙.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

本.gloss: measure word for books and notebooks

meanings.en: measure word for books and notebooks
meanings.note: Pinyin: běn. Counts bound volumes, notebooks, ledgers, and albums (一本书, 一本账本).

examples.text: 等等——柜台上这本棕色小皮笔记本是谁的？
examples.trans: Wait—whose small brown leather notebook is this on the counter?

examples.text: 书桌上放着两本旧乐谱。
examples.trans: Two old music books sit on the desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lái. Movement toward the speaker, as main verb or directional complement (进来 'come in').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shù yè. Measure word (量词): 片 (piàn), e.g. 一片树叶 ('a leaf').

examples.text: 没错。外面大街很吵，进了院子却只听见树叶和小鸟。
examples.trans: Exactly. Outside on the main road it is noisy, yet inside the courtyard you only hear leaves and birds.

examples.text: 风一吹，绿树叶沙沙地响。
examples.trans: When the breeze blows, the green leaves rustle softly.

根.gloss: measure word for pipes, wires, sticks

meanings.en: measure word for pipes, wires, sticks
meanings.note: Pinyin: gēn. Counts long, thin rod-like or cord-like objects (一根水管 'a water pipe', 一根电线 'a wire').

examples.text: 先生，到了。小心碰头，这根木房梁比较低。
examples.trans: Here we are, sir. Mind your head—this wooden beam is fairly low.

examples.text: 老木匠换了一根新的铜水管。
examples.trans: The carpenter replaced it with a new copper water pipe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lóu shàng. Measure word (量词): 层 (céng), e.g. 楼上房间 ('an upstairs floor').

examples.text: 老陈早！楼上洗澡水真的已经凉了吗？
examples.trans: Morning, Chen! Is the shower water upstairs really cold already?

examples.text: 早上好！在楼上就闻到暖暖的肉桂香味了！
examples.trans: Good morning! All the way upstairs I smelled warm cinnamon!

meanings.note: Pinyin: lóu tī. Measure word (量词): 座 (zuò), e.g. 一座楼梯 ('a staircase').

examples.text: 正合我心意。楼梯在哪儿？
examples.trans: Just what I wanted. Where are the stairs?

examples.text: 等等——三楼楼梯上面是什么地方？
examples.trans: Wait—what is above the stairs on the third floor?

meanings.note: Pinyin: méi. Short form of 没有; negates 有 and past/completed actions (没锁 'isn't locked / didn't lock').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huá. Describes wet stone steps being slippery or an object sliding down.

examples.text: 周经理！这回您眼镜从鼻子上滑下来是因为太高兴啦！
examples.trans: Manager Zhou! This time your glasses slid off your nose from sheer joy!

examples.text: 听我把箱子斜过来——里面有金属东西滑了一下。
examples.trans: Listen as I tilt the box—something metal slid inside.

meanings.note: Adjective rèqíng ('warmhearted, enthusiastic').

examples.text: 现场聚集了许多热情的观众朋友们。
examples.trans: Many enthusiastic audience friends gathered on site.

examples.text: 林姐对新来的同事其实很热情。
examples.trans: Lin Jie is actually warm toward hardworking newcomers.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ài. Expresses love for people, places, or favorite habits.

examples.text: 那里住着一位老木匠和两个孙子——哥哥弹钢琴，弟弟最爱小火车！
examples.trans: An old carpenter lived there with two grandsons—the older brother played piano, and the younger loved toy trains!

examples.text: 街坊们都爱来院子里喝早茶。
examples.trans: The neighbors all love coming to the courtyard for morning tea.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòng. Works as main verb ('use a key') or preposition ('with/using').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 别担心！用冰气泡水一擦，橙汁就掉。
examples.trans: Do not worry! Wipe it once with cold sparkling water and orange juice comes right out.

meanings.note: Pinyin: diàn xiàn. Measure word (量词): 根 (gēn), e.g. 一根电线 ('an electric wire').

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 电线本来就该拉直了。正常保养，别多想。
examples.trans: The wire needed straightening anyway. Routine maintenance—don't read into it.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Links modifiers or owners to nouns (我的书 'my book', 安静的院子 'quiet courtyard').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn. Covers looking at something, reading silently, or visiting someone; add 见/到 for 'catch sight of'.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhēn. Exclamatory adverb before adjectives (真好！ 'How nice!') or adjective 'genuine'.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

examples.text: 真奇怪！我们坐同一班早火车到同一个区。
examples.trans: How strange! We rode the very same morning train to the same district.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǎn jing. Measure word (量词): 双 (shuāng), e.g. 一双眼睛 ('a pair of eyes').

examples.text: 天哪……看这双眼睛！第三级台阶上的小志豪？！
examples.trans: Good heavens... look at those eyes! Little Zhihao from the third step?!

examples.text: 咬一口……志豪，闭上眼睛！跟爷爷的蛋糕味道一模一样！
examples.trans: One bite... Zhihao, close your eyes! That tastes exactly like Grandfather's cake!

related.gloss: a pair of eyes (measure word 双)

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhe. Placed right after a verb to show a state or posture continues (门开着 'the door stands open').

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

meanings.note: Classifier/noun zhāng ('chapter of a book or thesis').

examples.text: 我的论文就还剩最后一章。
examples.trans: My thesis has only the final chapter left.

examples.text: 这本书一共有十章。
examples.trans: This book has ten chapters in all.

meanings.note: Pinyin: duān. Specifically describes carrying dishes, soup, or tea level in the hands.

examples.text: 好。端上去之前，在上面撒这些新鲜绿香草。
examples.trans: Good. Before serving them, sprinkle these fresh green herbs on top.

examples.text: 她端着一盘热面包走出来。
examples.trans: She walked out carrying a tray of warm bread.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dì. Placed before any number to turn it into an ordinal (第一 'first', 第二天 'the second day').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: děng deng. Urgent or casual reduplication of 等 ('wait!').

examples.text: 等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！
examples.trans: Wait—it is dark blue, the same as yours!

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǜ. Describes green leaves, doors, or green tea.

examples.text: 好。端上去之前，在上面撒这些新鲜绿香草。
examples.trans: Good. Before serving them, sprinkle these fresh green herbs on top.

examples.text: 对，过了桥，右手边会经过一家绿药店。
examples.trans: Right, after crossing the bridge, you pass a green pharmacy on your right.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fān. Used for flipping open a notebook (翻开) or doubling an amount (翻一倍).

examples.text: 当然不能偷看……咦，自己翻开在中间那页了！
examples.trans: Of course we must not peek... oh, it fell open to the middle page by itself!

examples.text: 昨晚您的本子在柜台翻开了，我们看到九分……
examples.trans: Last night your notebook fell open on the counter, and we saw nine points...

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǎo. Describes longtime friends, historic lanes, or warm respect before a colleague's surname (老陈).

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 所以老房子自己会打招呼？
examples.trans: So the old house says hello by itself?

meanings.note: Pinyin: kěn dìng. Colloquial cousin of 一定 for confident predictions.

examples.text: 箱子的主人肯定很快会来找的。
examples.trans: The suitcase's owner will surely come looking for it soon.

examples.text: 只剩三十五分钟了！他肯定会写一星差评！
examples.trans: Only thirty-five minutes left! He will surely write a one-star bad review!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zì jǐ. Follows pronouns to stress 'by oneself' (你自己 'you yourself').

examples.text: 所以老房子自己会打招呼？
examples.trans: So the old house says hello by itself?

examples.text: 那个人为什么不拿回自己的箱子就跑了？
examples.trans: Why did that person run off without taking his own suitcase back?

meanings.note: Pinyin: huā yuán. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个小花园 ('a small garden').

examples.text: 啊！看这儿：一楼，九号房，花园阳光房！
examples.trans: Aha! Look here: ground floor, Room Nine, garden sunroom!

examples.text: 等等，我们一楼有一个花园阳光房？
examples.trans: Wait, we have a garden sunroom on the ground floor?

meanings.note: Pinyin: huā cǎo. Measure word (量词): 盆, e.g. 一盆花草 ('a pot of plants').

examples.text: 总得有人照顾院子里的花草嘛。
examples.trans: Somebody has to look after the courtyard plants, after all.

examples.text: 好位置。两把结实椅子，朝着花草，别朝着大堂窗户。
examples.trans: Good spot. Two sturdy chairs, facing the plants rather than the lobby window.

related.gloss: a pot of plants (measure word 盆)

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a noun used in conversational Mandarin. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个草本 ('a 草本').

examples.text: 我有一个草本。
examples.trans: I have a 草本.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的草本。
examples.trans: This is a very good 草本.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bò he. Measure word (量词): 片 (piàn) or 把 (bǎ). Note the special pronunciation bò he for this specific plant name.

examples.text: 茶杯里飘出淡淡的薄荷清香。
examples.trans: A faint, refreshing mint fragrance wafted from the teacup.

examples.text: 小晴摘下几片薄荷叶，洗干净后放进了冰水里。
examples.trans: Qing picked a few mint leaves, washed them clean, and dropped them into the ice water.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tuì sè. Joins 褪 ('to take off, to shed') + 色 ('color'). Can also be pronounced tùn sè.

examples.text: 阳光晒久了，墙上的旧海报已经严重褪色。
examples.trans: Having been exposed to the sun for a long time, the old poster on the wall has severely faded.

examples.text: 这件深蓝色的外套洗了几次后，有点褪色了。
examples.trans: After a few washes, this dark blue jacket has faded a little.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yào shi. Everyday spoken 'if', often paired with 就 in the main clause.

examples.text: 等等——要是每天早上打开院门，卖街坊咖啡和热面包……
examples.trans: Wait—if we open our courtyard gate every morning for neighbourhood coffee and warm bread...

examples.text: 周经理，要是你不正式聘用她，我就请她进我厨房！
examples.trans: Manager Zhou, if you do not hire her permanently, I am hiring her into my kitchen!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiàn. Appears in farewells (再见, 明天见) and as result complement of perception (看见, 听见).

examples.text: 晚安，小晴。明天早餐见。
examples.trans: Good night, Qing. See you at breakfast tomorrow.

examples.text: 老陈，听得见吗？我刚经过绿药店！
examples.trans: Chen, can you hear me? I just passed the green pharmacy!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǎo luò. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个角落 ('a corner').

examples.text: 当心那把角落椅子，等十秒我拧紧螺丝。
examples.trans: Mind that corner chair—wait ten seconds while I tighten the screw.

examples.text: 为小院客栈干杯——成都最热闹的安静角落！
examples.trans: Cheers to Courtyard Inn—the liveliest quiet corner in Chengdu!

meanings.note: Pinyin: ràng. Everyday causative/polite-offer verb (让我看看 'let me have a look').

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 宋老师，让我来给您倒新鲜橙汁！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, allow me to pour fresh orange juice for you!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jì. Used both for jotting down notes (记下) and holding in memory (记住).

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

examples.text: 快问他叫什么名字！记下来！
examples.trans: Quick, ask him what his name is! Write it down!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuō. Most common verb of speaking.

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

examples.text: 我还没喝早咖啡呢，千万别说急事！
examples.trans: I have not had my morning coffee yet; please do not say emergency!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuí. Question pronoun for people; stays in the exact spot of the answer (这是谁的？ 'Whose is this?').

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

examples.text: 一点没破！是谁送回来的？
examples.trans: Not cracked at all! Who brought it back?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǒu. Means 'walk' (走路, 直走) or 'leave / head off' (我先走了).

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chèn. Introduces a favorable moment before it passes (趁热吃 'eat while it's hot').

examples.text: 趁着阳光亮，我能再看看那张小纸牌吗？
examples.trans: While the sunlight is bright, may I look at that small paper tag again?

examples.text: 太好了……趁着等他们，我扫一眼这封房东来信。
examples.trans: Wonderful... while we wait, let me glance at this letter from the landlord.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ruǎn diàn. Combines 软 ('soft') + 垫 ('cushion/pad'); measure word: 个 (gè) or 块 (kuài).

examples.text: 小美哭笑不得地说：“你是想让我坐在软垫上指挥大家干活？！”
examples.trans: Mei laughed half in disbelief: 'You want me to sit on a soft cushion and direct everyone at work?!'

examples.text: 木椅子上加了一块厚实的亚麻软垫，坐一整个下午也不累。
examples.trans: With a thick linen cushion added to the wooden chair, you can sit all afternoon in comfort.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qīng qīng. Reduplication of 轻 ('light/soft'), used directly before short verbs or with 地 (轻轻地抽出来).

examples.text: 宋老师用两根手指把旧乐谱轻轻抽了出来。
examples.trans: Teacher Song gently slid the old music sheet out with two fingers.

examples.text: 怕吵醒午睡的客人，小晴轻轻关上了木门。
examples.trans: So as not to wake guests napping at noon, Qing closed the wooden door softly.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hái. Everyday adverb meaning 'still' (还在), 'not yet' (还没), or 'even more' after 比.

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

examples.text: 宋老师，真对不起，那边还没有消息。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, I am truly sorry; they have no news over there yet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè. Proximal demonstrative; pairs with a measure word before nouns (这个 'this one', 这间房 'this room').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lián. Pairs with 都/也 to highlight 'even X' (连名字都一样), or means 'connect' as a verb.

examples.text: 老房子连着旧回忆——那种争吵最伤人。
examples.trans: Old houses are tied to old memories—arguments like that cut deepest.

examples.text: 笔挺又干净，周经理！连眼镜都戴在鼻子上，没在额头上。
examples.trans: Crisp and spotless, Manager Zhou! Even your glasses are on your nose instead of your forehead.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà. Distal demonstrative before measure words (那个 'that one'); at clause start, means 'then / well then'.

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nàr. Spoken variant of 那里 ('there').

examples.text: 因为楼梯窄，而且周经理在那儿放了旧灯箱子。
examples.trans: Because the stairs are narrow, and Manager Zhou put old lamp boxes up there.

examples.text: 看车轮底下——铅笔写的你和我的名字还在那儿。
examples.trans: Look underneath the wheels—your name and mine in pencil are still right there.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lín jū. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位邻居 ('a neighbor').

examples.text: 超过八十年的小院建筑，只要一楼每天服务街坊邻居，禁止改成私人办公室。
examples.trans: Any courtyard building over eighty years old may not become private offices as long as the ground floor serves neighbours daily.

examples.text: 每天服务街坊邻居——就像对公众开放的早间咖啡馆？！
examples.trans: Serves neighbours daily—like a morning café open to the public?!

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǐ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 里面 ('the inside').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

examples.text: 职场里边很复杂，你听我的，先顾自己。
examples.trans: Inside the workplace things are complicated; listen to me and look after yourself first.

examples.text: 这是里边。
examples.trans: This is 里边.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jīn. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块金子 ('a piece of gold').

examples.text: 正往前走……啊，看见金钥匙招牌和蓝木门了！
examples.trans: Walking forward now... oh, I see the golden key sign and the blue wooden door!

examples.text: 阳光下，铜招牌闪着金光。
examples.trans: In the sunlight, the brass sign gleamed gold.

related.gloss: a piece of gold (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: líng. Measure word (量词): 只 (zhǐ), e.g. 一只铃铛 ('a small bell').

examples.text: 您好好休息，有事随时按铃。
examples.trans: Rest well, ma'am; ring the bell anytime if you need anything.

examples.text: 有客人按了前台的小铜铃。
examples.trans: A guest rang the small brass bell at reception.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiān bǐ. Measure word (量词): 支, e.g. 一支铅笔 ('a pencil').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 上面怎么用铅笔整齐画了这条街三家客栈？
examples.trans: Why are three inns on this street neatly sketched in pencil on it?

meanings.note: Pinyin: mén pái. Combines 门 ('door/gate') + 牌 ('numbered plaque/plate'); measure word: 块 (kuài) or 个 (gè).

examples.text: 小晴惊讶地认出他来：“您是梧桐巷十号门牌小提琴店的老邻居？！”
examples.trans: Qing recognized him in surprise: 'Are you our old neighbour from the violin shop at number ten Wutong Lane?!'

examples.text: 老陈把擦得干干净净的铜门牌端端正正钉在大门旁边。
examples.trans: Chen nailed the freshly polished brass doorplate squarely beside the front gate.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yáng guāng fáng. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间阳光房 ('a sunroom').

examples.text: 啊！看这儿：一楼，九号房，花园阳光房！
examples.trans: Aha! Look here: ground floor, Room Nine, garden sunroom!

examples.text: 等等，我们一楼有一个花园阳光房？
examples.trans: Wait, we have a garden sunroom on the ground floor?

meanings.note: Pinyin: yè. Counts pages directly without 个 (第二页 'page two').

examples.text: 当然不能偷看……咦，自己翻开在中间那页了！
examples.trans: Of course we must not peek... oh, it fell open to the middle page by itself!

examples.text: 仔细看这一页——记的是分贝和安静度，不是酒店星级！
examples.trans: Look closely at this page—it records decibels and quietness, not hotel stars!
